- tests import `dataset_isolation` by bare name, so run a single module from inside tests/: `cd tests && python3 -m unittest test_ui` [tests/dataset_isolation.py]
- the full `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` takes over 10 minutes; run only the modules you touched [tests/check.sh]

## Known traps
- python3 -m unittest test_models from ui/tests fails with ModuleNotFoundError: forge_ui; run the forge-ui suite from ui/ so that directory is on sys.path [ui/tests/test_models.py]
- forge-ui browser tests skip without Python Playwright, so a green ui suite does not exercise the DOM [ui/tests/test_browser.py]
- several test modules in one `python3 -m unittest` process make test_decide_wire fail (order leak, also on d3f6028); tests/run_tests.py runs each class… [tests/test_decide_wire.py]
- ForgeTable (datatable.js) rebuilds its whole table on sort, column move and hide without notifying the caller, so anything mounted into a header… [ui/forge_ui/static/datatable.js]
- a path that sets a task INTERRUPTED outside forge-schedule.py must run forge-guard.py stop on tasks/<id>/{dwarf,qa}.harness first, because the… [scripts/forge-schedule.py]
- macOS has no `timeout` command, so wrapping a test run in `timeout N` fails with exit 127 [tests/run_tests.py]
- `run --dry-run` returns before `preflight_plan`, so a dry run never calls doctor [scripts/forge-parallel.sh]
- forge-parallel.sh fails a retry whose diff is byte-identical to the previous attempt unless retry_findings.source is `bounce`; any new unreviewed-retry… [scripts/forge-parallel.sh]
- `forge brief write --task` skips a task that already has `brief.json`; only `--force` regenerates it, despite the `apply --no-regenerate` note in… [scripts/forge_brief/__init__.py]
- ui/forge_ui/export.py blanks a key in _TEXT_KEYS_UNDER only when clean() is given that parent; a route whose JSON is the object itself is not nested, so… [ui/forge_ui/export.py]
- macOS has no `timeout` command, so wrapping a test run in `timeout N` fails with exit 127 before any test starts [tests/run_tests.py]
- ui/forge_ui/export.py skips SCRIPTS entries whose file is absent (`if (STATIC / name).is_file())`), so a script can be listed before the file exists [ui/forge_ui/export.py]
